messages:
Mia Chen: tiny UI thing — when the new compact modal opens from the dashboard header, the top edge sits almost flush with the header on 1024px width. Looks cramped.
Sam Patel: can repro. Which modal variant is this? compact vs cozy?
Mia Chen: compact. It's the quick-filter modal you trigger from the search pill.
Zara Khan: I think this regressed after we reduced modal vertical padding in the density pass. Breadcrumb/header still uses the larger shell gap token.
Arjun Iyer: current css: ```css
.modal.compact { padding: var(--spacing-dense-1) 16px; }
.app-header { padding-bottom: var(--shell-gap); }
```
Arjun Iyer: proposal: introduce mid token `--spacing-dense-2` and use it for modal top and header bottom so the gap is consistent.
Mia Chen: also seeing a related issue: stacked toasts (bottom-left) get hidden behind the persistent mini-player when both present. Toasts are viewport-anchored.
Oliver Park: I'll take the toast fix. We should rely on `--shell-bottom` instead of absolute bottom and place toast container inside `.app-shell` so it respects the player.
design-bot: lint warning — referenced token "--spacing-dense-2" not found in tokens.yml. Consider adding to spacing scale. (lint-5467)
Zara Khan: plan: 1) add `--spacing-dense-2` (10px); 2) update modal.top and header.bottom to use it; 3) move toast container into shell and set bottom calc to include `--shell-bottom`.
Sam Patel: accessibility note — when the modal lands directly under the header, NVDA reads header then dialog. Ensure modal gets focus trap immediately and ARIA `aria-modal=true` is present. Also double-check `aria-labelledby` doesn't reference header IDs.
Mia Chen: good catch. Add to PR checklist.
Oliver Park: PR for toasts incoming — moving markup and using `bottom: calc(var(--shell-bottom) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));` Visual diffs queued.
Sam Patel: PR for token and modal patch opened. Included aria fix and a short comment in tokens.yml. Staging link posted.
Mia Chen: reviewed both PRs, spot-checked staging at narrow/wide. Spacing looks much cleaner, toasts no longer hidden. Screen reader test passes on latest build.
Mia Chen: merging now. Thanks team, closing thread.
